title: dryopteris scabra var. bifrons
intro: Dryopteris scabra var. bifrons, commonly known as Rough Buckler Fern, is a type of flowering plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a medicinal plant traditionally used in Asia for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Rough Buckler Fern include wound healing, fever reduction, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
